sections.title: About Grupo Caballero
texts: Grupo Caballero is a family business founded in 1830 in El Puerto de Santa María (Cádiz). It makes and distributes spirits and wines, with brands such as Ponche Caballero.
Almost two centuries later it is still a family business: many shareholders, several generations and meetings that must be called and documented properly.
